change: Prototype one asynchronous Daytona session submission, event-driven log observation and same-command identity/status checks. Explicit Remote(session_process=...) retains the existing nonce/argv/timeout/log-hash verification and read-only receipt recovery. Standard factory entrypoints still use the original transport.
activation: Opt-in prototype only. No standard entrypoint or frozen campaign activated it.
sdk_finding: The sync client’s async log method opens its WebSocket through synchronous connect_ws before awaiting the stream. The fully async implementation awaits connection setup. Prototype refuses a synchronous create_session method before any mutation.

internal_transport_timeouts.total: Unchanged existing worker-execution timeout (scientific seconds+25), with original receipt recovery inside seconds+55/campaign deadline. These are transport waits, not new scientific/model/request/repair allowances.

coverage: One submission only; quoting is preserved and no sync fallback or local command execution occurs.
Fast completion and event-driven stream completion require matching command identity/status.
A lost stream can recover from the same completed command; a closed but pending stream cannot establish completion.
Cancellation/deadline, lost create/submit acknowledgements, command identity mismatch and incomplete completion remain uncertain and never resubmit.
Known-completed session cleanup errors do not mask command results; unknown commands stay with owner cleanup.
Remote validates original nonce/argv/log and recovers a lost submission acknowledgement without another dispatch.
Nonzero wrapper stdout/stderr remain private and block subsequent execution; existing source/import/offline/setup/grading/cleanup behavior remains covered.

limits: No live compatibility, notebook, model or cloud run has used this prototype.
This does not yet establish that the original135provider stall is fixed.
Future stage integration must own and close AsyncDaytona client lifetime and retain source/compute/time/budget policy.
No task-specific scientific change, source patch, additional model call/repair or acceptance override. Frozen round026payloads unchanged.
